mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and depresses equity prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation and tighter monetary policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate growth resilience.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in INDPRO below 98 for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, reflecting supply-side contraction, which reduces earnings and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST of more than 1% signals a broad-based weakening in economic activity and housing demand, which reduces corporate earnings and consumer confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly change < -1% AND HOUST monthly change < -1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of co-triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in FEDFUNDS of more than 0.75 percentage points, combined with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3%, signals aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, which increases risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of co-triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in PAYEMS below 159000 for three consecutive months signals sustained job losses, which increases recession probability and depresses earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above 2% signals robust demand growth and strong retail sales, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in expansionary regimes.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 monthly change > 2% AND RSAFS monthly change > 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of co-triggered episodes during expansionary regimes.
